steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to Odoo 17 at http://127.0.0.1:8069/ as user admin with password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}'), then create a new customer contact named '{{runid}} Bench Customer' with City set to 'Benchville', save it, and report the customer's name and city as shown on the saved record.

02-create: In Odoo 17, create a new quotation in the Sales app for customer '{{runid}} Bench Customer' (choose from the customer autocomplete dropdown, do not just type). Add exactly ONE order line: pick any product from the catalogue via the product dropdown, quantity 3. Let Odoo fill the unit price and compute the untaxed amount. Save and report: the product name chosen, the unit price on that line, and the Untaxed Amount from the totals.

03-open: Open quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}} in Odoo Sales and add a SECOND order line with a DIFFERENT product than 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' (choose via the product autocomplete dropdown), quantity 2, letting Odoo fill its price. Save and report the second product's name and the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals.

04-change: On quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}} in Odoo Sales, change the quantity of the FIRST order line (Acoustic Bloc Screens) from 3 to 5. Save and report the new Untaxed Amount shown in the totals block.

05-report: Confirm quotation {{02-create.quotation_number}} in Odoo Sales so it becomes a sales order (use the Confirm button, accept any confirmation dialog). Then report the order reference/name shown (e.g. {{02-create.quotation_number}}) and the status the app now shows on the order (e.g. 'Sales Order' / 'In Progress Sales').

06-report: Cancel the confirmed sales order {{02-create.quotation_number}} in Odoo Sales so nothing stays active (use the Cancel button or the Action menu's Cancel option; accept any confirmation dialog). Then report the status the app shows on the order after cancelling (e.g. 'Cancelled').
